sifudog.d: When activated, teleports to the nearest base. Cannot be used inside dungeons or similar areas.

skydragon.d: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases Attack of Dragon Pals. (Does not stack)

skydragon_grass.d: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Leaf and increases Attack.

sleeverabbit.d: While in party, reduces the Partner Skill cooldowns for other party Pals. (Does not stack)

smallarmadillo.d: While in party, increases Defense of Earth Pals. (Does not stack)

smallyeti.d: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack)

snakegirl.d: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Darkness. (Does not stack)

snowpeafowl.d: While in party, Frostplume's icy aura sharpens focus, increasing the player's reload speeds. (Does not stack)

snowtigerbeastman.d: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with a hammer forged from Ice.

soldierbee.d: While in party, increases Elizabee's Attack. Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to Ranch.

stuffedshark.d: When activated, Finsider changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack.

stuffedshark_fire.d: While in party, Finsider Ignis helps carry supplies, reducing the weight of weapons in your inventory. Also improves player's and Pals' Fire damage to enemy weak points. (Does not stack)

sumodog.d: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take less Electricity damage and are immune to Electrical. (Does not stack)

suzaku.d: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases for each other Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku)

suzaku_water.d: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases for each other Water Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku Aqua)

sweetssheep.d: Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals. (Does not stack)

sweetssheep_ground.d: Sometimes drops Caramel Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals. (Does not stack)

swordcutlassfish.d: When activated, Skutlass becomes the player's katana (Attack:). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.

swordcutlassfish_fire.d: When activated, Skutlass Ignis becomes the player's katana (Attack:). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass Ignis will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.

tentacleturtle.d: While in party, reduces Ore weight. (Does not stack)

tentacleturtle_ground.d: While in party, reduces weight of Sulfur and Coal. Also improves player's and Pals' Earth damage to enemy weak points. (Does not stack)

thiefbird.d: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Darkness. (Does not stack)

thunderbird.d: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electricity and increases Attack. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases for each other Electricity Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon)

thunderbird_ice.d: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases for each other Ice Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon Cryst)

thunderdog.d: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases for each other Electricity Pal in your party. (Excluding Rayhound)

thunderdog_ice.d: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While in party, increases Defense of Ice Pals. (Does not stack)

thunderdragonman.d: While in party, hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack.)

thunderfluffybird.d: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While at a base, shortens the time it takes to incubate eggs. (Does not stack)

tropicalostrich.d: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased while mounted on grass.

umihebi.d: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Wetness. (Does not stack)

umihebi_fire.d: Can be ridden. While in party, nullifies lava damage and increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Burn. (Does not stack)

venusflytrap.d: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, Carnibora creates a whirlwind that deals damage to enemies it touches (Leaf / Power:). (Does not stack)

violetfairy.d: While in party, Earth Pals drop more items when defeated. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops various seeds when assigned to Ranch.

volcanicmonster.d: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of all types of ore. (Does not stack)

volcanicmonster_ice.d: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of all types of ore. (Does not stack)

volcanodragon.d: Can be ridden as a mount. This Pal's Attack increases for each other Fire or Earth Pal in your party.

volcanodragon_ice.d: Can be ridden. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Ice damage to enemy weak points. (Does not stack)

weaseldragon.d: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Dragon and increases Attack.

weaseldragon_fire.d: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack.

werewolf.d: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Jumping Claw. When this Pal uses Jumping Claw, it has a x damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed. (Does not stack)

werewolf_ice.d: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Snow Claw. When this Pal uses Snow Claw, it has a x damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed. (Does not stack)

whitealiendragon.d: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the player's energy weapon damage. (Does not stack)

whitedeer.d: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increases for each other Normal Pal in your party. When in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals per second. (Does not stack)

whitedeer_dark.d: Can be ridden. While in party, the Pal fighting alongside you gradually loses Health in exchange for Attack increase. (Does not stack)

whitemoth.d: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Blizzard Spike. When this Pal uses Blizzard Spike, it has a x damage multiplier. Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch.

whitemoth_neutral.d: While in party, increases Defense of Normal Pals. (Does not stack) Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch.

whiteshielddragon.d: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces shield regeneration delay and reduces damage taken by your shield. (Does not stack)

whitetiger.d: While in party, Dragon Pals drop more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

whitetiger_ground.d: While in party, when attacking enemy weak point, increases the power of the next weak point attack. (Does not stack)

windchimes.d: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding.

windchimes_ice.d: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding.

winggolem.d: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem's Attack and Defense for a limited time.

winggolem_fire.d: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem Ignis's Attack and Defense for a limited time.

wizardowl.d: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals. (Does not stack)

woolfox.d: While in party, increases Attack of Normal Pals. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

worldtreedragon.d: This Pal's abilities are still being investigated.

yakushimaboss001.d: When activated, Eye of Cthulhu charges and attacks targeted enemy.

yakushimaboss001_small.d: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals. (Does not stack)

yakushimamonster001.d: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

yakushimamonster001_blue.d: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

yakushimamonster001_pink.d: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

yakushimamonster001_purple.d: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

yakushimamonster001_rainbow.d: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

yakushimamonster001_red.d: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

yakushimamonster002.d: While in party, Dark Pals drop more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

yakushimamonster003.d: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

yakushimamonster003_purple.d: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

yeti.d: Can be ridden. While at a base, increases the Transport Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +. (Does not stack)

yeti_grass.d: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take less Earth damage and are immune to Muddy status. (Does not stack)
